data.one_liner: Flutter bindings for state_notifier, providing StateNotifierProvider and StateNotifierBuilder.
data.what_it_does: It connects StateNotifier objects to the Flutter widget tree using provider integration. It allows creating and disposing notifiers as well as rebuilding UI when the state changes.
use_when: You want to manage state using state_notifier in a Flutter app
You need StateNotifierProvider to integrate with provider
avoid_when: You use modern state management libraries like Riverpod or Bloc instead
strengths: Simple integration with the provider ecosystem
weaknesses: Dependent on older state_notifier and provider architectures
Not documented with advanced features beyond basic widgets

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides general state management primitives directly without requiring a separate state notifier library.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Uses a robust stream-based architecture for state management and UI rebuilding.

alternatives.name: flutter_riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: A modern evolution of provider and state_notifier that is safer and more robust.
